about: Synthetic triage test cases for scripts/latency_test.py and scripts/benchmark_models.py. Made up for testing: no real patient data. expected_risk is a draft label written for the benchmark; it must be reviewed by the client's medical advisor before the results are used as clinical evidence. The red-flag cases follow the rule in app/shared/prompts.py (chest pain, difficulty breathing, loss of consciousness, seizure and vomiting blood are always critical).

cases.message: I have had a mild runny nose and sneezing since yesterday. No fever, eating and sleeping normally.
Small paper cut on my finger this morning. It stopped bleeding quickly and looks clean.
Slight muscle soreness in my legs after a long walk yesterday. No swelling, I can walk fine.
Tengo un poco de congestión nasal desde ayer, sin fiebre y me siento bien en general.
Me duele un poco la cabeza después de un día largo de trabajo frente a la computadora. Ya casi se me quitó.
I feel a bit tired today after sleeping badly last night. Otherwise I feel normal.
Fever of 38.5 C for two days with sore throat and body aches. I am drinking fluids.
Burning when I urinate and needing to go often since yesterday. No fever, no back pain.
Ankle twisted while running an hour ago. It is swollen and painful but I can put some weight on it.
Tengo diarrea desde hace dos días, unas cinco veces al día, sin sangre. Puedo tomar líquidos.
Tos con flema desde hace una semana y un poco de fiebre por las noches.
Rash on my arms that itches, started after I used a new soap two days ago. No trouble breathing.
Fever of 39.5 C for three days that does not go down with medicine, and I feel very weak.
Severe pain in the lower right side of my belly for 12 hours, getting worse, with nausea.
Deep cut on my hand from a kitchen knife, still bleeding through the bandage after 20 minutes of pressure.
Soy diabético y mi glucosa ha estado arriba de 350 todo el día, tengo mucha sed y orino mucho.
Tengo una herida en el pie que está roja, caliente, con pus y huele mal desde hace tres días. Soy diabético.
Vomiting everything I drink since this morning, very dizzy when I stand up, and I have not urinated in 10 hours.
Crushing chest pain spreading to my left arm for 20 minutes, sweating and nauseous.
Sudden difficulty breathing, I can only say a few words at a time and my lips look blue.
My father suddenly cannot move the right side of his face and arm and his speech is slurred, it started 15 minutes ago.
Tengo dolor en el pecho muy fuerte y me falta el aire desde hace media hora.
Mi hijo tuvo una convulsión hace unos minutos y ahora está muy somnoliento y no responde bien.
I vomited blood twice in the last hour and I feel faint.
